B: Disulfiram chelates copper to inhibit NF-κB and ALDH+ cancer stem cells, reducing SOX2 and stemness
C: Impaired tumor initiation and chemoresistance in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
statement: Disulfiram, an anti-alcoholism drug, suppresses PDAC stemness via copper-dependent NF-κB blockade.

B: Mebendazole blocks microtubule polymerization and downregulates the Hedgehog pathway through inhibition of SMO trafficking
C: Reduced desmoplasia and Hedgehog-driven proliferation in PDAC
statement: Mebendazole, an anthelmintic, attenuates PDAC by disrupting Hedgehog signaling and stromal desmoplasia.

B: Propranolol blocks beta-2 adrenergic receptors on PDAC cells and macrophages, reducing ADRB2-mediated CREB/STAT3 activation and M2 polarization
C: Suppressed tumor innervation, catecholamine-driven proliferation, and immune evasion in PDAC
statement: The beta-blocker propranolol inhibits ADRB2 signaling to limit neural-tumor crosstalk and M2 macrophage polarization in PDAC.

B: Loperamide activates the mitochondrial protease OMA1, leading to OPA1 cleavage, mitochondrial fragmentation, and apoptosis in KRAS-mutant PDAC cells
C: Synthetic lethality in KRAS-driven PDAC through mitochondrial catastrophe
statement: Loperamide, an opioid receptor agonist, exploits mitochondrial vulnerability in KRAS-mutant PDAC through OMA1-OPA1 axis disruption.

B: Itraconazole inhibits Smoothened and also targets mTORC1 via cholesterol trafficking disruption and AMPK activation
C: Dual inhibition of Hedgehog and mTOR signaling, leading to autophagy and growth arrest in PDAC
statement: The antifungal itraconazole suppresses PDAC growth by concurrently blocking Hedgehog and mTOR pathways through cholesterol handling interference.

B: Diclofenac inhibits lactate transporter MCT4 and COX-2, reducing lactate-driven immunosuppression and PGE2 synthesis in the PDAC microenvironment
C: Repolarization of tumor-associated macrophages and enhanced CD8+ T cell infiltration in PDAC
statement: Diclofenac, an NSAID, reverses immune evasion in PDAC by blocking MCT4-mediated lactate export and COX-2 activity.

B: Fluvastatin blocks HMG-CoA reductase, depleting farnesyl pyrophosphate and geranylgeranyl pyrophosphate, leading to impaired KRAS membrane anchoring and YAP/TAZ nuclear exclusion
C: KRAS delocalization and mechanotransduction shutdown in PDAC cells
statement: Fluvastatin disrupts KRAS membrane localization and YAP/TAZ signaling in PDAC by inhibiting protein prenylation.

B: Bromocriptine, a dopamine D2 receptor agonist, inhibits dopamine-mediated cAMP/PKA/CREB signaling in PDAC cells and stellate cells
C: Reduced fibrosis and dopamine-driven proliferation in PDAC
statement: Bromocriptine, used in prolactinoma, suppresses PDAC growth and fibrosis by antagonizing dopamine-D2 receptor signaling in tumor and stroma.

B: Minocycline inhibits PARP-1 and NF-κB, and blocks IL-6/STAT3 signaling in pancreatic stellate cells, reducing senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) and fibrosis
C: Attenuated stromal activation and tumor-promoting inflammation in PDAC
statement: Minocycline, a tetracycline antibiotic, mitigates PDAC stromal desmoplasia by suppressing PARP-1/STAT3-driven SASP in stellate cells.

B: Ezetimibe blocks NPC1L1-mediated cholesterol uptake in PDAC cells, leading to endoplasmic reticulum stress and ferroptosis due to lipid peroxidation
C: Induction of ferroptotic cell death in PDAC cells
statement: The cholesterol absorption inhibitor ezetimibe induces ferroptosis in PDAC by disrupting cholesterol homeostasis and increasing lipid peroxidation.

B: High-dose zinc ionophores into PDAC cells, inhibiting the NF-κB pathway and reactivating mutant p53 (R175H) zinc-binding defect
C: Restoration of p53 tumor suppressor function and apoptosis in p53-mutant PDAC
statement: High-dose zinc reactivates zinc-binding-deficient mutant p53 in PDAC, leading to apoptosis.

B: Dipyridamole inhibits equilibrative nucleoside transporter 1 (ENT1), blocking adenosine salvage and causing pyrimidine starvation, while also suppressing STAT3 and NF-κB
C: Imposed nucleotide stress and anti-inflammatory effects in PDAC
statement: Dipyridamole, an antiplatelet drug, induces nucleotide starvation and suppresses STAT3-driven inflammation in PDAC.

B: Ritonavir inhibits glucose transporter GLUT4 and fatty acid synthase, and blocks proteasome, leading to ER stress and downregulation of HIF-1α in hypoxic PDAC regions
C: Metabolic crisis and apoptosis in hypoxic PDAC cells
statement: The HIV protease inhibitor ritonavir starves PDAC cells by blocking GLUT4 and fatty acid synthase, inducing ER stress.

B: Tranylcypromine inhibits lysine-specific demethylase 1 (LSD1), leading to derepression of epithelial genes (e.g., E-cadherin) and inhibition of the mesenchymal program driven by ZEB1 in PDAC
C: Reversal of epithelial-mesenchymal transition and reduced metastasis
statement: The MAO inhibitor tranylcypromine suppresses LSD1 to reverse EMT and inhibit PDAC metastasis.

B: Amlexanox inhibits TBK1 and IKK-ε, blocking IRF3-driven CCL5 secretion and STAT3 signaling, thereby disrupting the immunosuppressive TGF-β/CCL5 loop in PDAC
C: Reduced regulatory T cell recruitment and enhanced anti-tumor immunity
statement: Amlexanox, an anti-aphthous ulcer drug, relieves immunosuppression in PDAC by targeting TBK1/IKK-ε to block CCL5 secretion.
